t: You're at the Estorick Collection of Modern Italian Art, a museum on Canonbury Square in Islington. It's the only gallery in the country devoted to modern Italian art, and it's a registered charity. It's named for Eric Estorick, who lived from 1913 to 1993. He was an American art collector, dealer and author who lived in London and ran the Grosvenor Gallery. He and his wife Salome endowed the collection, which is why it exists here in north London.
